svg.title: Screen for recoverable value, not list size
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-deal-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: Screen for recoverable value, not list size; subtitle: Illustrative cohort of 200 sale records; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Invented nested cohort counts; no observed conversion rate or collection forecast is implied.; caption: Keep a reason code for every rejected record and distinguish an engaged claimant from an actual cash collection.; stages: label: Sale records; value: 200; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Deduplicated case and parcel records from one defined acquisition period.; label: Balance verified; value: 80; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Custodian confirmation supports a still-held balance rather than a stale auction-list amount.; label: Net claim plausible; value: 32; numeric value: 32.0; detail: Preliminary lien and deadline screening leaves a potentially economic claimant share.; label: Claimants engaged; value: 8; numeric value: 8.0; detail: Eligible claimants choose assistance after receiving a clear scope and fee calculation.; label: Fees collected; value: 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Resolved cases with cleared business receipts; pending matters remain outside this count.
